emails.subject: Invoice #1234 overdue
emails.body: Dear customer, our records show that invoice #1234 for 2,450 EUR was due on 1 November and remains unpaid. Please arrange payment within 7 days to avoid a late fee. If you have already paid, kindly send us the remittance details.

emails.subject: Weekly engineering sync
emails.body: Agenda: review of last sprint, the database migration plan for Q1, and the API latency incident from Tuesday. Please add your topics to the doc before Thursday 10:00. The release checklist will be finalised at the end of the meeting.

emails.subject: Company retreat announcement
emails.body: We invite you to our annual company retreat in Bergen on 12-14 June! Colleagues from all offices will join for workshops, team-building activities and a celebration dinner. Our marketing team will share photos from the event on our social media channels, so please let HR know if you prefer not to appear.
